product_overview: Event Manager is a web application for administrators and staff to create events, manage guests, handle QR-based check-in, and control media experiences during live events. It provides authenticated event operations plus a public display screen that reacts to check-ins in real time.
core_goals: Create and manage events from a central dashboard.
Search, filter, and browse owned events efficiently.
Add, edit, finalize, and delete event information.
Manage guest lists through manual entry and bulk import.
Generate QR invitations and assign guest media.
Check guests in with QR scanning or manual fallback.
Monitor attendance through live check-in stats and recent activity.
Run a public display screen that plays assigned welcome videos in real time.

features.name: Administrator Login
features.description: Allows an administrator to sign in and access protected event management pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email or username -> Enter password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Leave required fields empty -> Submit the login form -> See validation messages
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See an authentication error

features.name: Dashboard Event Browsing
features.description: Lets the authenticated user review event summary metrics and browse their events.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View total events, managed guests, and average attendance summaries -> Search events by name, location, type, or venue -> Filter events by status -> Toggle the list layout -> Select an event -> Open the event detail page
Navigate to / -> View the empty or populated dashboard event list -> Change the status filter -> Narrow the visible events -> Reset or adjust the search query -> See the list update

features.name: Event Creation
features.description: Enables the user to create a new event from the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Start creating an event -> Enter the event name, type, date, venue, location, and expected guest count -> Submit the form -> See the new event appear in the dashboard list

Navigate to / -> Start creating an event -> Omit required information or enter invalid values -> Submit the form -> See validation errors -> Correct the fields -> Submit again -> See the event created

features.name: Event Information Management
features.description: Allows the user to review and update event details, finalize an active event, or delete an event.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open an event -> Switch to the Información tab -> Review the event details -> Enable editing -> Change event fields -> Save the changes -> See the updated information
Navigate to / -> Open an event -> Switch to the Información tab -> Start finalization -> Confirm the action -> See the event marked finalized
Navigate to / -> Open an event -> Switch to the Información tab -> Start deletion -> Confirm the action -> Return to the dashboard without the event

features.name: Guest Management
features.description: Supports managing attendees with manual entry, Excel import, search, filters, pagination, QR generation, media assignment, and deletion.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open an event -> Switch to the Invitados tab -> Search guests by name, email, or table -> Filter guests by status -> Page through the guest list -> Review matching guests
Navigate to / -> Open an event -> Switch to the Invitados tab -> Add a guest manually -> Fill in guest details -> Submit the form -> See the guest added to the list
Navigate to / -> Open an event -> Switch to the Invitados tab -> Import guests from Excel -> Provide a valid file -> Complete the import -> See the imported guests in the table
Navigate to / -> Open an event -> Switch to the Invitados tab -> Generate QR codes in bulk -> Wait for progress updates -> Download the generated QR assets when ready
Navigate to / -> Open an event -> Switch to the Invitados tab -> Generate an individual guest QR -> Download the QR image
Navigate to / -> Open an event -> Switch to the Invitados tab -> Assign a video to a guest -> Save the assignment -> See the guest updated
Navigate to / -> Open an event -> Switch to the Invitados tab -> Delete a guest -> Confirm the deletion -> See the guest removed from the list

features.name: Check-In Workflow
features.description: Lets staff check guests in by scanning QR codes or searching manually while viewing live attendance information.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open an event -> Switch to the Escaneo QR tab -> Review total, present, absent, and attendance percentage stats -> Search for a guest manually -> Confirm check-in -> See the guest marked present
Navigate to / -> Open an event -> Switch to the Escaneo QR tab -> Start QR camera scanning -> Scan a guest QR code -> See successful check-in feedback -> Review the recent check-ins list
Navigate to / -> Open an event -> Switch to the Escaneo QR tab -> Scan or submit the same guest again -> See duplicate check-in feedback instead of a second check-in

features.name: Media Management
features.description: Allows the user to upload event videos, manage the media list, assign media in bulk, and configure QR card invitation assets.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open an event -> Switch to the Multimedia tab -> Upload a supported video file with metadata -> See the video appear in the media list
Navigate to / -> Open an event -> Switch to the Multimedia tab -> Open an uploaded video -> View it in a new tab or preview context
Navigate to / -> Open an event -> Switch to the Multimedia tab -> Delete a video -> Confirm the deletion -> See the media removed from the list
Navigate to / -> Open an event -> Switch to the Multimedia tab -> Bulk assign media to guests -> Save the assignment -> See the guests updated with media
Navigate to / -> Open an event -> Switch to the Multimedia tab -> Upload a QR card image or PDF -> Save the QR card asset -> Configure QR slot coordinates -> Save the slot position

features.name: Public Display Screen
features.description: Provides a public event screen that connects in real time and plays guest welcome videos when check-ins occur.
user_flows: Navigate to /display/:id -> Observe the connection status -> Wait in the idle state -> See the display ready for playback
Navigate to /display/:id -> Observe the connection status -> Toggle audio on or off -> Wait for a check-in-triggered playback event -> See the guest welcome overlay and video playback
Navigate to /display/:id -> Observe recent guests on the screen -> Receive a playback event for the current event -> See the assigned welcome video start playing

known_limitations.issue: Metrics tab is a placeholder and displays a coming soon message.
known_limitations.impact: No metrics interactions are currently available for automated E2E assertions beyond placeholder rendering.

known_limitations.issue: Login page development hint says admin / 123456, but the seeded Docker account is admin@eventmanager.com / admin1234.
known_limitations.impact: Tests should use the seeded email/password account rather than the dev hint.

known_limitations.issue: Camera-based QR scanning depends on browser camera permissions and hardware availability.
known_limitations.impact: TestSprite should prefer API-assisted or manual check-in tests for deterministic coverage.
